keyFindings.description: Fixed by the reviewer: the ReplyToBlock field doc gave only the reply_to half of the rule; it now names namedReplyBlock and the ask_id half.
Fixed by the reviewer: the comment cited ItemBlockNode, which 1b769383 deleted; it now cites ParseItemBlockNode.
Fixed by the reviewer: the header gave an option part's text as '<label> — <description>' only; askOptionText writes the label alone when there is no description.

Not a defect: the file is 1003 lines (940 on main). The repository has no length rule, and dispatch already holds non-test files of 1500 to 2700 lines (docs/service.go, docs/mutation.go, model/model.go). Moving the item-kind helpers is a design preference, not worth a test round.

Not a defect: replyBlockProblem maps three item kinds to their reply field in a three-arm ternary. A lookup table would be tidier, but the behaviour is right, each arm is tested, and a fourth kind is not planned.

Not a defect: two tests capture a ToolInputError inline where the file's refusal() helper would do it; test style, with no effect on what they prove. ITEM_KINDS losing its satisfies clause is also not a defect: isItemKind's `kind is ItemKind` predicate must be assignable to GraphNode['kind'], so drift still fails to compile.
